cacheAdvice.policy: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on completed checksum-read ranges <= 16 MiB for files >= 8 MiB
cacheAdvice.scope: Read-only original bytes and identical SHA-256. Advice is not guaranteed eviction; no source synchronization, edits or global cache drop.

originalRoadKeys.scope: Three existing numeric arrays retained by reference; excludes object/allocator overhead. No per-road ID strings or membership set.

sampling.scope: Periodic samples can miss brief composition peaks. Field maxima are not simultaneous and must not be summed. memory.peak is a separate cumulative kernel counter; host/VM paging is unmeasured.

scope: Storage-only calibration of the already qualified two-hour graph; all eight payload artifacts must match. Exact repeat build and bound existing independent/native/cut proofs are required before claiming the follow-up complete. No new routes, contour, real eligibility, six-hour admission or coverage claim. Final checkpoint follows all artifact verification reads; small metadata writes excluded.
